title: Seller Performance Standing Terms: Action-Plan Relief
content:
**Terms.** A seller whose standing record is in good standing or at risk and carries active points above zero may apply for action-plan relief after working through the account health action plan for the listings behind their active violations; applying is the seller's own act and is confirmed by the seller. Action-plan relief takes points off before any violation's point expiry period has passed.

Action-plan relief is fixed only after the standing record carries a points-expiry entry for every clean-span relief owed on it. Put the other way round, the action-plan relief figure is settled on a Seller Performance Standing record on which each clean-span relief owed already stands as a points-expiry entry.

For action-plan relief, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a date lies in the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N whole months have passed from it to the handling date.

## Who may apply

| Condition | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Status of the standing record | good standing or at risk |
| Active points on the record | above zero |
| What the seller has done | worked through the account health action plan for the listings behind their active violations |
| Who applies | the seller, as the seller's own act, confirmed by the seller |

## How the relief is booked

The action-plan relief is booked as one points-expiry entry against the active violation that still carries the most points, the oldest of them where two carry the same, and the entry carries that violation's type; where the relief exceeds that violation's remaining points, the rest is booked the same way against the next. A violation that has received action-plan relief keeps its remaining points on record until they expire or are reversed, and a violation already reversed or fully expired never receives relief.

**Hypothetical booking.** Active violations carry 4 points (recorded in March) and 4 points (recorded in May). A relief of 5 points is booked first against the March violation, the older of the two equal ones, for 4 points, and the remaining 1 point against the May violation.

## Application tool: `apply_action_plan_relief_841772f9`

**Capability.** The seller applies, on their own account, for action-plan relief after working through the account health action plan for their listings: the given number of violation points is taken off the seller's active violation points and recorded as a points-expiry entry dated today against one policy violation. The active violation points shown on the standing record drop by exactly that number, and the entry appears in the seller's standing activity with today's date, the violation reference, its type and the points taken off.

**How it is invoked.** This is the seller's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the seller with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, under the tool name `apply_action_plan_relief_841772f9`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `standing_id` | Identifier: the reference number of the seller's performance standing record, as given to the seller by the support agent from the standing record lookup. |
| `violation_ref` | Identifier: the policy violation reference number the relief entry is booked against, as given to the seller by the support agent from the standing activity. |
| `violation_type` | Enum: the kind of policy violation the entry is booked against, copied from that violation's record; exactly one of `listing_policy`, `restricted_product`, `intellectual_property`, `inauthentic_complaint`, `product_authenticity`, `review_manipulation`. |
| `points` | Fixed format: the number of violation points the seller applies to have taken off, a positive whole number (integer points, no decimals), as worked out and told to the seller by the support agent. |

**Return.** A receipt with `entry_id` (reference of the new points-expiry entry), `standing_id`, `violation_ref`, `points` (points taken off), `active_points_before` and `active_points_after`. A returned `entry_id` means the relief is booked and the standing record already shows `active_points_after`.
